newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - S&P assigns QTC samurai bonds 'AAr'.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - S&P assigns QTC samurai bonds 'AAr'.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday it has assigned its AAr rating to Queensland Treasury Corp's 20 billion yen dual currency conditionally redeemable samurai bonds -- first series (1996), maturing December 9, 1999.

S&P said the rating reflected that of its guarantor, the state of Queensland. "The 'r' subscript is not an indication that the securities are of lower credit standing than other QTC bonds. Rather, the 'r' subscript is an indicator that the bonds carry risks other than credit risk, in this case, exchange rate risk on redemption," the credit rating agency.
The rating on these bonds was constrained by the 'AA' foreign currency sovereign rating of the Commonwealth of Australia. The foreign currency rating outlook is positive.
QTC is the central borrowing agency for the Queensland state's public sector. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
